settings.label: Meet Chef Matt
settings.heading:
40 Years in the Kitchen.
Now Cooking for You.
settings.text: Chef Matthew brings classical French training, family-restaurant roots, and experience across multiple cuisines to every container he packs. Every meal balances clean eating with big, satisfying flavour. No shortcuts, no fillers - just food that works for your goals.
settings.quote: "I have been a private chef for 40 years, and now my only goal is to cook flavorful, healthy meals for all of Lake Country."
settings.author: Matthew, Founder and Chef

settings.image_alt: Salmon with rice and carrots, annotated with macros
settings.label: Built for Balance
settings.title: Protein, carbs, and veggies in every container.
settings.text: Every meal is built around a lean protein, a smart carb, and a serving of veggies, so your plate stays balanced without any extra thought. Macros portioned right, to help you hit your goals meal after meal.

settings.image_alt: BBQ chicken meal in a 24oz container
settings.label: Generous Portions You Can Count On
settings.title: 24oz every time. You won't go hungry.
settings.text: Every meal comes packed in a 24oz container, giving you satisfying portions that keep you full for hours.

settings.label: Better for You. Better for the Planet.
settings.title: Eco-friendly packaging on every order.
settings.text: Every meal is packed in environmentally friendly containers - designed to reduce waste without cutting corners on quality or freshness. Clean food in clean packaging. That is the Chef Matt standard.

settings.image_alt: Rotating menu of Chef Matt meals

settings.text: Chef Matt adds new meals every two weeks. More choices, more variety. You will always find something you love.
